leave_one_heating_rate_out.note: n=4 endpoint removal has high leverage; spread reported honestly, not hard-gated.

non_circularity: Estimator consumes ONLY raw (beta, Tp). Paper Ea values are validation targets, never inputs. Recovered Ea and its regression SE independently reproduce the paper's reported Kissinger Ea and uncertainty.
physics_note: Kissinger peak-based Ea sits at the low edge of the iso-conversional envelope (KAS/FWO/Starink 59.8-62.8), as expected: peak-only Kissinger underestimates the conversion-averaged apparent Ea. Cross-method spread 5.5 kJ/mol confirms internal consistency.
relation_to_cure_potlife: Supplies the FIRST rights-clean, in-scope kinetics anchor for the cycloaliphatic-amine reactivity class.
